profiles.packet_template: Build a deterministic model-family comparison packet that treats the corrected reference mass-balance family as the release baseline and the advective family as a governed experimental challenge path.
profiles.brief_template: Summarize whether the experimental advective family materially changes the screening interpretation relative to the corrected reference family for the same scenario.
profiles.comparable_outcome_template: Treat the comparison as a sensitivity check showing that the governed advective challenge path does not materially change the screening interpretation for this scenario.
profiles.divergence_outcome_template: Treat the comparison as a material model-family divergence and review residence-time assumptions, equation traces, and applicability before preferring the experimental family.
profiles.review_needed_outcome_template: Do not reuse the comparison in decision-facing review until model-family applicability limitations are resolved for both the baseline and candidate families.

review_checklist.prompt: Confirm the comparison remains inside the governed reference-versus-advective screening scope and that the candidate family is being treated as a challenge path rather than a default replacement.
review_checklist.rationale: Assessor-facing comparison review should preserve the declared baseline-versus-experimental relationship rather than implying family interchangeability.

review_checklist.prompt: Review whether both model families remain inside their governed applicability profiles for the matched scenario.
review_checklist.rationale: Comparison results are only meaningful when both families are being run inside their declared screening scope.

review_checklist.prompt: Review the dominant surface deltas together with the executed equation traces before preferring or qualifying the candidate family.
review_checklist.rationale: Assessor-facing comparison review should make the executed screening equations and the main divergence points explicit.

profiles.review_packet_template: Build a governed assessor-facing review packet for the reference-versus-advective screening comparison, preserving baseline-versus-experimental framing, fit/applicability context, dominant deltas, and equation traces.
profiles.review_brief_template: Summarize whether the governed reference-versus-advective comparison is ready for assessor-facing review, highlighting applicability, dominant deltas, and experimental-family caution.
review_notes: Use this comparison profile when the reference family is the screening baseline and the advective family is being challenged on the same scenario.
Interpret the candidate family as experimental and non-default even when the comparison shows material differences.
Escalate to richer transport methods when the decision context is dominated by spatial hydrodynamics or intermedia transfer.
profiles.applicability_note: This profile is intended for governed reference-versus-advective screening comparisons inside the concentration-only Fate MCP boundary.

profiles.display_name: Reference vs Fugacity Equilibrium Screening Comparison
profiles.packet_template: Build a deterministic comparison packet treating reference_mass_balance as the baseline and fugacity_equilibrium_screening as an experimental equilibrium-partitioning challenge path.
profiles.brief_template: Summarize whether the experimental fugacity equilibrium family materially changes screening interpretation relative to the reference family.
profiles.comparable_outcome_template: Treat the comparison as a bounded partitioning sensitivity check when outputs are comparable and applicability remains satisfied.
profiles.divergence_outcome_template: Treat divergence as a material model-family signal requiring review of Henry, Koc, molecular weight, and equilibrium-partitioning assumptions before downstream reuse.
profiles.review_needed_outcome_template: Do not reuse the comparison until both baseline and fugacity applicability limitations are resolved.

review_checklist.prompt: Confirm the candidate family is being treated as experimental Level I/II equilibrium screening, not Level III or routed transport.
review_checklist.rationale: Comparison review must preserve non-default challenge framing.

review_checklist.prompt: Review molecular weight, Henry law constant, and Koc provenance before interpreting partitioning deltas.
review_checklist.rationale: Fugacity outputs are sensitive to explicit physchem inputs.

review_checklist.prompt: Review dominant media deltas together with the fugacity calculation traces.
review_checklist.rationale: Assessor-facing comparison should identify whether partitioning, not routing, drives divergence.

profiles.review_packet_template: Build a governed review packet for the reference-versus-fugacity comparison, preserving experimental-family caution, applicability, dominant deltas, and equation traces.
profiles.review_brief_template: Summarize whether the reference-versus-fugacity comparison is ready for assessor-facing review.
review_notes: Use only for steady_state fugacity challenge comparisons.
Do not interpret the candidate family as a default replacement for reference_mass_balance.
Escalate when Level III transfer, routing, calibration, or field validation is required.
profiles.applicability_note: Comparison profile for bounded reference-versus-experimental fugacity screening only.
